description: This file contains a test double implementation of the NewsResourceDao interface, providing mocked data and behavior for unit testing parts of the application that depend on news resource data. It includes methods for querying, inserting, and deleting news resources, with features like filtering by topic and news IDs.

classes.name: TestNewsResourceDao
classes.description: A test implementation of the NewsResourceDao interface, providing in-memory operations suitable for unit testing.

methods.name: getNewsResources
methods.description: Returns a flow of filtered lists of populated news resources based on topic and news ID filters.

methods.name: getNewsResourceIds
methods.description: Returns a flow of news resource IDs filtered according to specified topic and news ID filters.

methods.name: upsertNewsResources
methods.description: Updates or inserts provided news resource entities into the in-memory store, maintaining order by publish date.

methods.name: insertOrIgnoreTopicCrossRefEntities
methods.description: Adds new topic cross-reference entities to the in-memory list, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: deleteNewsResources
methods.description: Removes news resources with specified IDs from the in-memory store.

methods.name: asPopulatedNewsResource
methods.description: Extension function converting a NewsResourceEntity and cross-references into a PopulatedNewsResource with associated topics.
